subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR's sidebar image-sizing fix, ask that contributor for proof, or replace it with a narrow OpenClaw-targeted PR?
rationale: The remaining source-visible fix is small, but an open linked fork PR already owns the candidate implementation and needs maintainer handling before this issue should close or spawn another fix PR.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar markdown image cap change with focused Web UI proof.

options.title: Ask the fork PR for proof
options.body: Keep this issue open while requesting before/after browser evidence from the linked PR author.

options.title: Reject the sidebar scope
options.body: Close or detach the linked PR only if maintainers decide the reported Web UI chat symptom needs a different proven root cause.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar markdown image cap change with focused Web UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current Web UI image-sizing rules and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether sidebar/main-chat parity is the intended fix.
